title: Camera exposure compensation +1 EV
description: Same as 'defaults' but with camera.exposure_compensation_ev = +1.0. The negative receives one stop more light; because enlarger.print_exposure_compensation stays enabled the enlarger re-normalises the print exposure against the compensated mid-grey reference.

enlarger.exposure_factor_note: the exposure factors are scalars (upstream shape 1 x 1 x 1) that are broadcast over the three channels of the print exposure

print_balance.shape_note: the upstream arrays are 1 x 1 x 81 (one mid-grey patch), they are stored here flattened in wavelength order
